title: Keep rule: what the repo keeps, and a report of files nothing needs
item: Write the keep rule into DECISIONS.md, and add a script that lists candidate files for the owner to remove. The script only reports; nothing deletes without the owner's yes
motivation: On 2026-11-16 two folders sat in eval/agent-spec/results/ that nothing needed (a test fixture and a try-out run); they made every /grade list 2 judge tasks. Claude first recommended keeping them and changing grade.py. The owner's rule: a file is not needed when nothing in the repo reads it and it is not the owner's decision, human-labelled data, client data or external knowledge. The owner wants the first test raised by a lint, the other four written down as direction, and to be asked before any deletion.
notes: Two parts. (1) DECISIONS.md, a short section: the five tests; agents never delete and may only propose; the owner approves every deletion; where each kept class lives (owner's decisions and rulings: DECISIONS.md, eval/*/calibration/, the frozen trial inputs; these are already 'named' lines in protected-paths.txt). (2) A report script, exit 0 always, run at the owner's review, not on every commit. 'Nothing reads it' cannot be found by searching for a file's name alone: README named switch-smoke-1 and grade.py walked it, and it still was not needed. So start narrow, where the test can be stated exactly: a folder under eval/<skill>/results/ is a candidate when it is not a baseline label in grading.json, not cited in EXPERIMENTS.md, and not named in a test. Tried by hand on 2026-11-16 after commit fc42319: 49 folders, 14 baseline, 25 cited and not baseline, 10 neither (standin-1 and switch-base-1 to -9); standin-1 is named in test_grade_build2.py, which leaves 9. Skip every protected 'named' path. Widen to other folders only if the narrow report proves useful.
done_means: DECISIONS.md states the keep rule: the five tests, that agents never delete, and that the owner approves every deletion. A script prints the results folders that are not a baseline label, not cited in EXPERIMENTS.md and not named in a test, for every eval/<skill>/; it deletes nothing and exits 0. Its tests pass. Run on the tree at fc42319 it prints switch-base-1 to switch-base-9 for agent-spec and does not print standin-1 or any baseline label.
draft_note: Drafted by Claude in chat on 2026-11-16 at the owner's request. The DECISIONS.md wording is the owner's to approve: which is why verified_by includes you. The script's home is left to the builder; if it goes under .claude/skills/manage/, that path must be added to may_edit by the owner first. Priority is a draft.
